from_speaker: Wall Street is going to need to see some sort of return

our_interpretation: The ordinary observable counterpart of Wall Street needing returns is investors or their analysts explicitly pressing hyperscalers to demonstrate financial returns on AI investment.
The sentence also asserts that AI investment returns were negative when the post appeared. Both components must be established to support the complete claim.

For the current financial component, use July through September 2025, the latest completed quarterly reporting period before the post. This is an evaluator choice, not a period supplied by the speaker.
Return is read as financial earnings attributable to AI investment after attributable costs. Revenue growth, broad cloud profits, and stock-price changes are not substitutes.
criteria.support_condition: A dated event after publication establishes material investor demands for AI investment returns, and matching financial evidence establishes negative AI-attributable returns in the latest pre-post quarter.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Matching financial evidence establishes positive rather than negative AI-attributable returns in the pre-post period. Failure to observe investor demands by an arbitrary date cannot refute the indefinite forecast.
